==Transportation==
* Teleport using [[Minigame Teleport]], either through any spellbook or the [[Grouping]] interface, by selecting Nightmare Zone. (Only usable when the requirements for Nightmare Zone are met)
* Casting [[Watchtower Teleport]] or using a [[Watchtower teleport]] tablet and running east. Both require completion of [[Watchtower]] quest to use.
* Casting [[Teleport to House]] or using a [[Teleport to house]] tablet if your [[player-owned house]] is in Yanille, or using a [[scroll of redirection]] on a [[Teleport to house]] tablet to make a [[Yanille teleport]].
* Using [[fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|CLS}} and walking north-west or code {{Fairycode|CIQ}} and walking through Yanille.
* Using a [[ring of dueling]] to teleport to [[Castle Wars]], then walking to Yanille.
* Using the [[Spirit tree]] to teleport to [[Tree Gnome Village (location)|Tree Gnome Village]] and walking from there.
* Using the [[Ardougne cloak 1]] to teleport to the [[Ardougne Monastery]] and walking south.
* Teleport using [[Minigame Teleport]], either through any spellbook or the [[Grouping]] interface, by selecting Fishing Trawler and walking south-west.
